summary: First e2e test run for SONGRIGHT. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed covering auth (login, register, /me, logout, duplicate email), profile update+persist, sessions CRUD, join-by-code, contributions, AI splits suggest (returned AI source with sum=100), splits set + approve (dual signature -> finalized), royalties. Frontend: all critical flows exercised end-to-end - landing hero, login as seed user, dashboard, profile update+persistence, session create, add contribution, suggest AI splits, save+approve splits, split-sheet button appears, Vaulta page, sign-out. Google auth button present. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: Emails are silently lowercased server-side; register response returns lowercased email even if client sent mixed case. Not a bug, but worth documenting.
Any collaborator can call approve even before splits are set (splits==None). Would benefit from a 400 guard when splits are missing.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby -> a11y warning in console. Add DialogDescription for screen-reader support.
Two 401 console errors on landing (likely /api/auth/me probe before token exists). Consider suppressing or checking token presence before firing the request.

action_items: Add DialogDescription to Add-Contribution DialogContent to remove a11y warning
Skip /api/auth/me call on public routes when no songright_token is in localStorage (removes noisy 401s)
Optionally: reject /splits/approve with 400 if session.splits is null
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines and mixes storage, auth, sessions, splits, royalties, uploads - consider splitting into modules (auth.py, sessions.py, splits.py, royalties.py) for maintainability
AI splits code path parses model output via find('{')/rfind('}') without validating percentages sum ~100; existing normalization saves it but strict schema validation via pydantic would be safer
startup seeded user has fixed user_id 'user_seed_test001' but does not update password_hash on subsequent starts - fine for MVP, but flag if credentials rotate
CORS is fully open (default '*') AND allow_credentials=True - browsers reject '*' with credentials; production must set explicit origins
Emergent session cookie is set with SameSite=None, Secure - correct for cross-site, but ensure preview URL is served over HTTPS (it is)
test_credentials: test@songright.com / Test1234! (seeded); collaborator users are dynamically registered per-run
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed collaborator accounts and sessions titled 'TEST_Skyline' / 'Skyline UI Test' for isolation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_songright_api.py — uses -n 2 --dist loadscope from /app/backend/pytest.ini. Session state shared via session-scoped 'session_state' fixture; keep tests in same module or same class so xdist loadscope pins them to one worker. Seeded account test@songright.com / Test1234! remains functional. AI splits returned source='ai' successfully via emergentintegrations + Claude Sonnet 4.5.
